intent: Continue the Bominal-grade cohesive Oyatie dashboard by upgrading Ledger Preview, Filing Readiness, and Service Catalog direct anchors into interactive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud commercial/catalog proof surfaces with SSR parity.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added dynamic and SSR-static trust proof boards to Ledger Preview, Filing Readiness, and Service Catalog using the shared trust-anchor design language.
Each remaining sparse direct anchor now states FD-001 product delivery, Oyatie Cloud dogfood substrate posture, and explicit local-only/no-mutation boundaries.

Extended data-trust-proof-action interactions for close staging, filing staging, catalog manifest staging, ledger/vendors/billing/filing/identity/daily routes, and existing cloud/policy/evidence/comms routes.
Preserved the existing dense Bominal-style dashboard while making commercial, localization, and catalog surfaces read as one product graph instead of separate modules.
